sahneler.metin: Two minutes after launch, a Falcon 9 rocket broke apart.
The cargo bound for the space station was destroyed.
The cause was hidden inside the second stage.
A steel strut held a helium tank in place.
It failed below its rated strength.
The tank broke free and helium flooded out.
SpaceX switched to struts tested one by one.

aciklama:
CRS-7 broke apart two minutes after launch. The cause: failure of a strut securing a helium bottle in the second-stage oxygen tank.
